tasks.title: Structured invocation tool + host dispatch (reuse the bounded sandboxed executor)
tasks.objective: Structured invocation tool + host dispatch for local_cli capabilities. FIRST pin and reuse the existing sandboxed output-bounded RunCommand executor (no second execution path). Tool takes {capabilityId, args:[]}; host resolves the granted capability against authority, validates argv structurally against the reviewed template (reject unreviewed subcommand/flag/excess/NUL/oversize, no shell), verifies executable identity at invocation, runs via that executor, returns bounded output.
acceptance_criteria: A granted local_cli capability runs from an args list with no shell string composed and no classifier consult; output bounded via the existing executor.
Argv is validated against the capability's reviewed pattern; an unreviewed subcommand/flag, excess arg, NUL, or oversized input is rejected.
The executable identity is verified at invocation; execution reuses the existing sandbox/timeout/cancellation not a bare execFile.

required_tests.id: CLIRUN-1-1 > structured local_cli invocation validates argv, verifies executable, bounds output
required_tests.command: VITEST_JUNIT=1 FORGE_TEST_ID={id} npx vitest run -c vitest.unit.config.ts {path} --outputFile {report}

tasks.title: Wire the pilot capability (gog) + agent guidance
tasks.objective: Wire the pilot local_cli capability (gog/sheets) to the structured tool and add agent guidance to prefer it over shelling the CLI out. Keep the RunCommand projection working for now (retired in CLIRUN-1-3). No cutover yet.
acceptance_criteria: The gog/sheets capability is invokable via the structured tool end to end.
Agent operating guidance prefers the structured tool over shelling the CLI.
The RunCommand projection still works (retirement is CLIRUN-1-3).

required_tests.id: CLIRUN-1-2 > pilot gog capability invokes structurally with guidance
required_tests.command: VITEST_JUNIT=1 FORGE_TEST_ID={id} npx vitest run -c vitest.unit.config.ts {path} --outputFile {report}

tasks.title: Cutover: retire the RunCommand projection for local_cli
tasks.objective: Cutover: retire the local_cli -> RunCommand(template) projection so it no longer authorizes these capabilities; ensure existing scheduled jobs invoke via the structured path. No dual-run. Only after the pilot is wired (CLIRUN-1-2).
acceptance_criteria: The local_cli -> RunCommand projection no longer authorizes these capabilities.
Existing scheduled jobs invoke the capability via the structured path (no dual-run).
A capability with no structured path is not stranded (pilot wired first).

required_tests.id: CLIRUN-1-3 > RunCommand projection retired for local_cli; structured path authorizes
required_tests.command: VITEST_JUNIT=1 FORGE_TEST_ID={id} npx vitest run -c vitest.unit.config.ts {path} --outputFile {report}
